potential_clients.summary: Across two internal strategy sessions, the Flow team has been developing a short Andalusian courtyard video series blending storytelling, Islamic themes, and history at roughly $125 per video, with production logistics still being finalized. A recurring and urgent theme has been a significant attribution and tracking breakdown caused by phone number changes, which must be fully audited and resolved before any new campaigns are launched.
